explanation: Fires only at D1 when the previous trial was unrewarded and is 0 at every GO and D2 step and at every D1 after a rewarded trial; its size shrinks over the episode, about 10 for trials 2-13 (8-9 if there was another loss two trials back), about 3-7 for trials 15-40, and 0 from about trial 45 on (also 0 at trial 0). In a run of consecutive unrewarded trials it is highest at the first loss and drops by about 2 at each further loss (for example 10, 8, 6, or 4, 2 later in the episode).
